note: Bought hardware by part name (parts flagged "hardware": true) or by derived item (hinge). Prices in KM per piece.

leg.product: Nogice za namještaj podesive 120mm 4/1 crne FE.9020

hinge.note: rough price per hinge; count is derived per door height in hardware.js

shelf support.note: 3 KM per pack of 100, so 0.03 per pin; 4 per shelf

runner.note: 8.50 KM per piece; modelled runners are one part per side

handle.note: 9 KM per piece; one per door leaf, drawer front and flap (dishwasher panel), drawn by the viewer

cabinet hanger.product: ovjes za viseće elemente (Camar/Häfele type), 2 per wall cabinet

wall rail.product: čelična šina za ovjes, per cabinet section

confirmat screw.note: approx. price per piece; modelled one part per screw at every fixed carcass joint

shelf pin.note: same pin as shelf support; when modelled explicitly these replace the derived 4-per-shelf count

rail holder.note: approx. price per piece; two per rail

plinth clip.note: approx. price per piece; one per front leg

staple.note: approx.; one per 150 mm of back edge

runner 550 cabinet part.note: approx. price per side; the matching drawer part comes with it
